IELTS Academic Writing Task 1

Band 7 practice bank: 70 original tasks with full visuals, revealable guidance, a function-based vocabulary bank and adaptable report frameworks. Synthetic practice data; not official IELTS material.

Practice instructions

Allow 20 minutes and write at least 150 words. Select and compare the main features; do not describe every value. Guidance is hidden until you choose to reveal it.

Vocabulary by language function

Color supports the text labels; it is never the only cue.

Adaptable four-paragraph report templates

Replace every bracketed item. These are planning frameworks, not memorised scripts.
